import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        // Reading input values
        long x = sc.nextLong();
        long y = sc.nextLong();
        long n = sc.nextLong();

        long a = 0, b = 0;
        double val = Math.pow(2, 60); // Equivalent to 1ll<<60 in C++

        for (long i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            long mod = (i * x) % y;
            double candidate = Math.min(mod, y - mod) * 1.0 / i;
            if (val > candidate) {
                val = candidate;
                b = i;
                if (mod <= y - mod) {
                    a = (i * x) / y;
                } else {
                    a = (i * x) / y + 1;
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(a + "/" + b);
        sc.close();
    }
}
